events.title: Former 맨체스터 시티 player-manager 피터 리드 signs a short-term playing contract with 사우샘프턴 , while 에버턴 striker Mo Johnson returns to his homeland after agreeing a contract with 하트 오브 미들로디언 .

게리 스피드 and 게리 매캘리스터 both score twice from midfield in a 4–0 home league win for 리즈 유나이티드 against 윔블던. 리버풀 hold 아스널 to a goalless draw at Anfield , allowing 맨체스터 유나이티드 to extend their lead of the Premier League after coming from behind twice to beat 셰필드 웬즈데이 3–2 away from home. 사우샘프턴 and 셰필드 유나이티드 draw 3–3 at The Dell . 크리스털 팰리스 maintain their lead of Division One with a 4–1 home win over 스토크 시티. 루턴 타운 climb of the bottom of the table in style with a 5–0 home win over 반즐리.

더비 카운티 manager Arthur Cox , who had already been under pressure after the club's poor start to the season, resigns due to health problems. His assistant, Roy McFarland replaces him as manager until the end of the season.
Jim Holton , who played for 맨체스터 유나이티드 at centre-half in the 1970s, dies from a heart attack at the wheel of his car. He was 42 years old.
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 manager 케빈 키건 rules him out of the running to take over as England manager if 그레이엄 테일러's reign is ended by failure to qualify for the 1994 FIFA World Cup.
England are left with little hope of qualifying for the 1994 World Cup after suffering a 2–0 defeat by the Netherlands in their penultimate qualifying game.

맨체스터 유나이티드 extend their lead of the Premier League to seven points with a 2–1 home win over 토트넘 홋스퍼. 노리치 시티 go second with a 2–1 win at 첼시, while 아스널 drop into third with a goalless draw at home to 맨체스터 시티. The big news in Division One is Southend's 6–1 home win over 옥스퍼드 유나이티드, which keeps up their surprise promotion push.
Lou Macari walks out on 스토크 시티 to succeed 리엄 브레이디 as manager of Glasgow club 셀틱 .
노리치 시티 become the first English team to beat German giants 바이에른 뮌헨 on their own soil, winning 2–1 in the UEFA Cup second round first leg.
맨체스터 유나이티드 surrender a two-goal lead over Turkish champions 갈라타사라이 to draw 3–3 in the European Cup second round first leg at Old Trafford.

맨체스터 유나이티드 extend their lead of the Premier League to nine points with a 1–0 win over 에버턴 at Goodison Park , with Lee Sharpe scoring the only goal of the game. Their nearest challengers 노리치 시티, 아스널 and Leeds all drop points, while QPR move into fifth place with a 5–1 home win over Coventry. 스윈던 타운 hold 토트넘 홋스퍼 to a 1–1 draw at White Hart Lane but are still bottom of the table and without a win after 12 games. 찰턴 애슬레틱 go top of Division One with a 1–0 win over 그림즈비 타운 at Blundell Park . 왓퍼드 keep up their promotion push with a 4–3 home win over Bolton.
사우샘프턴 boost their survival push with a 2–1 home win over 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, only their second league win of the season.
블랙번 로버스 pay 리즈 유나이티드 £2.75million for midfielder 데이비드 배티 .

18-year-old 리버풀 striker Robbie Fowler scores a hat-trick in a 4–2 home league win over 사우샘프턴. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 beat 윔블던 4–0 at home, and leaders 맨체스터 유나이티드 now have an 11-point lead after beating QPR 2–1 at Old Trafford, with their nearest rivals 노리치 시티 and 아스널 drawing 0–0 at Highbury. An entertaining mid-table game in Division sees Stoke beat 반즐리 5–4 at the Victoria Ground.

맨체스터 유나이티드 end October as Premier League leaders with an 11-point margin over their nearest rivals 노리치 시티, 아스널, 블랙번 로버스 and 애스턴 빌라 who are all bracketed together on points. Swindon are still bottom of the league and their winless run has now stretched to 13 games, while 사우샘프턴 and 셰필드 웬즈데이 are still in the relegation zone. 리버풀 have improved after last season's wobbles to occupy seventh place. 찰턴 애슬레틱 are top of Division One, with 레스터 시티 occupying second place. The playoff zone is occupied by 크리스털 팰리스, 트랜미어 로버스, 미들즈브러 and 더비 카운티. 노팅엄 포리스트 and 울버햄프턴 원더러스, who both began the season in promotion form, have slipped into the bottom half of the table.
